crossRefs.note: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because…
God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, Yahweh saw, and he relented of the disaster…
David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand…
All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and Yahweh’s glory was on the house. They bowed…
He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away…
One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…
the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne, and worship him who lives forever and ever, and…
The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.

translations.web: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
translations.bsb: Going a little farther, He fell to the ground and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour would pass from Him.
translations.kjv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
translations.asv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
